name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_launch_selected_session
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::LaunchSelectedSession initializes DirectPlay for the selected WOL session, creates or joins the session, registers the local player, applies game status, and disconnects the WOL API callback.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited around CString temporary lifetime and EH state rendering; assembly and typed call targets validate the WOL callback, DirectPlay, GameNet, HudSensorTracker, zLoc, MFC, USER32, and WOL API provider contracts.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x4404c0 validates the stdcall callback arguments, early negative-status return, dialog UpdateData(TRUE), selected session-list traversal by row flag bit 0, InitSessionRuntime with the Recoil application GUID, host IPv4 formatting, TCP/IP DirectPlay provider selection, create-session and join-session branches, local player registration, zOpt player/network updates, GameNet status flag propagation, HudSensorTracker timer/goal update, selected mission index update, connection-failure message box path, WOL API vtable Disconnect at offset 0x34, and return value 0.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_launch_selected_session_smoke verifies the early negative-status return, selected-node traversal, Recoil app GUID use, host address propagation, create-session status-field construction from dialog controls, session-mode SendMessageA event code, local player registration, join-session selected index and returned status fields, player-name update, GameNet/HudSensorTracker status application, selected mission index update, and final WOL API Disconnect.
